entries.section: 3. Method 1 — Inspector Observation Data (checklist observations view)
entries.what_the_parse_missed: the eight instruction callouts drawn on the Figure 20 screenshot; the saved agentic parse reduced them to 'screenshot: Inspector Observation Data interface with callouts explaining various features like filters, grouping, and saving.'
entries.text:
Figure 20 callouts (Inspector Observation Data screen):
* The header shows the Inspector name, the 'Due Date to Complete' and the Office 'Instructions to Vessel'.
* Use the available filters (Compliance, Applicable To, Source, Type, Status) to refine the displayed observations; 'Clear' resets them.
* Click the Excel icon at the top right of the toolbar to export the data.
* Observations are grouped by Question No. / Ref no.
* Use the column filters to narrow down the displayed records.
* Click the counters (Total Observations / Pending / Verified) to display Verified or Pending observations.
* Enter vessel comments in the 'Vessel Comments' column and select the applicable compliance status (Yes / No).
* Click 'Save' to save the updates ('Cancel' discards them).
